answer: I would stop farms with Certified sushi chef apprenticeship record with sushi association endorsement, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. A farm running 479 aliases would need 479 separate proofs, each costing about 110 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The quill test is the live device, the gale test is the locked stake, and the echo test is the graded history no template can fake. The panel can verify all of it from the chain, without trusting the submitter's word.
